Academia requires camera access to allow you to take profile pictures, scan QR codes, and capture photos to attach to posts and assignments.
Academia uses your location while the app is in use to display campus updates, local student feeds, and events near your university.
Academia uses your location to send location-relevant notifications and display campus updates, local student feeds, and events near your university.
Academia uses your location to deliver location-relevant notifications about nearby campus updates, events, and announcements.
Academia requires microphone access to record audio notes, create video attachments with audio, and participate in voice features.
Academia requires access to your photo library to let you select and upload profile photos, share image attachments in posts, and save media to your device.
Academia requires permission to save photos and media attachments directly to your photo library.
Academia requires access to your calendar to sync class timetables, exam dates, and academic deadline reminders.
Academia requires full calendar access to let you create, edit, and sync assignment deadlines and timetable events directly in your calendar.
Academia requires access to your reminders to sync study tasks, assignment deadlines, and personal study reminders.
Academia requires full access to your reminders to let you create and manage assignment deadlines and study tasks in your iOS reminders.
Academia uses app tracking to deliver personalized content, measure application performance, and provide relevant announcements and features.
Academia requires notification permission to alert you about assignment deadlines, timetable updates, and messages from peers.
